title: Mica Rain Wanted

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: You are the owner of this establishment, yes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are the owner of this establishment, yes?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Are you aware of the most common mistake made by business owners like you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you aware of the most common mistake made by business owners like you?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: They talk too much. Use seven words for a question that could have been answered with two. Those extra words are gold to someone like me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They talk too much. Use seven words for a question that could have been answered with two. Those extra words are gold to someone like me.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: We're not investigating your noodle stand without reason.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're not investigating your noodle stand without reason.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: I'm Mica Rain, an investigator from CorpSec's business hygiene and profitability commission. Unfortunately, there's been a string of illnesses, and the common thread seems to be your restaurant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm Mica Rain, an investigator from CorpSec's business hygiene and profitability commission. Unfortunately, there's been a string of illnesses, and the common thread seems to be your restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Severe cases of food poisoning. Many cases. We have two victims on emergency detox support.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Severe cases of food poisoning. Many cases. We have two victims on emergency detox support.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: It doesn't matter what you SAY you know. We have confirmed the details. The facts are clear. The evidence is irrefutable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It doesn't matter what you SAY you know. We have confirmed the details. The facts are clear. The evidence is irrefutable.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: The victims all say they ate here. We have witnesses in abundance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The victims all say they ate here. We have witnesses in abundance.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Listen, we know who delivered the groceries. We know you've been played. We need Edison.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, we know who delivered the groceries. We know you've been played. We need Edison.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: He delivered you poisoned groceries. But it's not even about that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He delivered you poisoned groceries. But it's not even about that.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: And I did not accuse you of poisoning. Yet. But the fact remains, people were made ill by the food served HERE.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I did not accuse you of poisoning. Yet. But the fact remains, people were made ill by the food served HERE.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: The common denominator was your chicken.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The common denominator was your chicken.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: You have twenty four hours to figure out how you can help me. If you can't come up with anything, you're mine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have twenty four hours to figure out how you can help me. If you can't come up with anything, you're mine.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: My line of inquiry leads me here. More investigation must be done.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My line of inquiry leads me here. More investigation must be done.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: You have no say in this my little entrepreneur. The investigation will proceed, and your freedom depends on your cooperation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have no say in this my little entrepreneur. The investigation will proceed, and your freedom depends on your cooperation.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: We've established people have been poisoned because they ate here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We've established people have been poisoned because they ate here.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Could they? And why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could they? And why?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Quaint. I wish you people would come up with something more... original.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Quaint. I wish you people would come up with something more... original.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Come on. He's not your friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come on. He's not your friend.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Human trafficking. It's a serious crime. I'll be honest, we could take you to a corporate paradigm adjustment center right now. You'd never see light again...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Human trafficking. It's a serious crime. I'll be honest, we could take you to a corporate paradigm adjustment center right now. You'd never see light again...

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: The common denominator was your pork belly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The common denominator was your pork belly.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: The common denominator was your onions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The common denominator was your onions.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Correct.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Correct.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Clearly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Clearly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You know I was JUST talking to Cecil?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know I was JUST talking to Cecil?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You know I was JUST talking to Cecil?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You know I was JUST talking to Cecil?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I suppose you're going to tell me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I suppose you're going to tell me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I suppose you're going to tell me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I suppose you're going to tell me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What kind of illnesses?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What kind of illnesses?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You can't prove anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can't prove anything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know anything about this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know anything about this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't know anything about this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't know anything about this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Confirmed it how?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Confirmed it how?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Chicken?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Chicken?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can you get to the point?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can you get to the point?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can you get to the point?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can you get to the point?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What exactly are you investigating?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What exactly are you investigating?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think Edison did this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think Edison did this?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I didn't poison anyone!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't poison anyone!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: All you know is that they say they ate here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All you know is that they say they ate here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: All you know is that they say they ate here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: All you know is that they say they ate here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is it about then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is it about then?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If they got ill, it was obviously a mistake.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If they got ill, it was obviously a mistake.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If they got ill, it was obviously a mistake.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If they got ill, it was obviously a mistake.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Get lost. I've got nothing to say to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Get lost. I've got nothing to say to you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Get lost. I've got nothing to say to you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Get lost. I've got nothing to say to you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Could someone be targeting my customers?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could someone be targeting my customers?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Could someone be targeting my customers?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Could someone be targeting my customers?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I won't rat out a friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I won't rat out a friend.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I won't rat out a friend.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I won't rat out a friend.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fuck off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck off.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want from me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want from me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you want from me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you want from me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't threaten me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't threaten me!

nodes.text: Pork Belly?
